about.title: About Ghevans Travel Peru
about.p1: Ghevans Travel Peru is a local private tour agency based in Cusco. We offer personalized experiences across the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, and the most iconic destinations in southern Peru.
about.p2: Our approach is simple: friendly service, clear logistics, and the flexibility of a local operator who knows the region. We pick up guests at their hotel — we don't have a walk-in office.
about.p3: Whether it's your first time in Cusco or a return to Machu Picchu, we design each tour so you feel supported and safe.

booking.q: How do I book a tour?
booking.a: Message us on WhatsApp with the tour you want, your dates, and group size. We'll confirm availability and details.

pickup.q: Do you have a physical office?
pickup.a: We don't have a walk-in location. We operate with hotel pickup in Cusco and coordinate everything via WhatsApp.

payment.a: Payment is arranged directly with you on WhatsApp. There is no online checkout on this website.

languages.a: We serve Spanish-speaking guests and can coordinate tours for English, Portuguese, and French-speaking visitors.

custom.a: Yes. Many of our tours are private and we can adapt the itinerary to your schedule and interests.
